declared.not_dependent_on: the running V1-V4 root-cause verification (configs/wp12/phase4_verification_protocol_v1.json, ecfa8c6): it tests causes and COUNTERFACTUAL variants, not law 8 at the formal resolution. A law or profile adopted after it gets a NEW envelope version.

scope: Physical admissibility for the WP-12 Phase 5 benchmark (spec 5.3 class 'physically_unsupported') of law 8, tlmpm_v5, ruler_knife_v2_y at 1 mm / 4 mm / 0.1 ms, kinematic ideal tracking unless a note says Native, with the WP-12 goal planner and controller_profile path_v2 (armed through-cut end 0.1-0.3 mm above the board top; the frozen v1 controller ends it 0.3-0.5 mm above and is a KNOWN FAILURE for pieces <= 10 mm on the flat board). INSIDE a bound means 'not declared physically unsupported, admissible for execution', NOT 'validated': each rule's note splits its admissible range into VALIDATED, PARTIALLY_VALIDATED and NOT_RUN parts and names the excluded KNOWN_FAILURE / UNSUPPORTED_BY_LAW / PHYSICALLY_INFEASIBLE parts. A bound is set at the edge of the first known failure or physical limit, or at the outermost value reviewed (the DRAFT OOD outer range); nothing beyond a bound is declared. Phase 5 ID ranges must lie inside the VALIDATED parts (decision report D5); generalization_wp12.freeze_problems checks only the admissible bounds and skips rules with a 'when' condition, so the ID check is the orchestrator's. Samples outside a bound are counted as physically_unsupported, never dropped and never counted as controller failures. Material parameters are provisional and uncalibrated; forces are not resolution-converged.

rule_semantics.parameter: a key of the sample's envelope_parameters (generalization_wp12.envelope_parameters); a rule whose parameter the sample does not carry is NOT_APPLICABLE
rule_semantics.when: optional {parameter: value} conditions; the rule applies only if every condition equals the sample's value
rule_semantics.kind: max: value <= max | min: value >= min | range: min <= value <= max | in_set: value in values | subset: every element of the value list is in values
rule_semantics.null_bound: a null bound is UNDECLARED: the rule is NOT_EVALUATED and the sample is marked envelope_pending (never silently supported or unsupported)
rule_semantics.evidence: the record that justifies the bound (report section, evidence file, commit)
